changeSet.author: trainer
changeSet.comment: Partitioned trades can't back a plain single-column FK on id; drop it and index trade_id directly instead.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE settlements DROP CONSTRAINT fk_settlements_trade;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE settlements ADD CONSTRAINT fk_settlements_trade FOREIGN KEY (trade_id) REFERENCES trades(id);

changeSet.author: trainer
changeSet.comment: trades becomes the RANGE(trade_date) parent; trade_ref uniqueness and the PK both widen to include trade_date so Postgres will accept them on a partitioned table.
